subtype.description: The Slack message subtype ('channel_join', 'bot_message', …) when the message has one.

userId.description: The user ID of the message author.

botId.description: The bot ID of the message author when a bot posted it.

appId.description: The Slack app ID that posted the message when an app posted it.

username.description: The display username Slack attached to a bot or app message.

teamId.description: The Slack team ID the message belongs to.

clientMsgId.description: The client-generated message identifier when Slack returns one.

text.description: The text content of the message.

editedTs.description: The timestamp of the most recent edit, when the message was edited.

threadTs.description: The timestamp of the thread parent. Equal to ts on a thread parent, and absent on a message that is not in a thread.

parentUserId.description: The author of the thread parent, on a threaded reply.

replyCount.description: The number of replies to this thread parent.

replyUsersCount.description: The number of distinct users who replied to this thread parent.

latestReply.description: The timestamp of the most recent reply to this thread parent.

name.description: The emoji name of the reaction.

count.description: How many users added this reaction.

userIds.description: The users who added this reaction, as far as Slack reports them.

items.description: A reaction summary on a Slack message.

reactions.description: Reaction summaries attached to the message.

messages.description: The list of messages in the conversation.

hasMore.description: Whether more messages are available beyond this page.

nextCursor.description: The cursor for the next page, or an empty string when this is the last page.

description: The output payload for this action.
